import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { orders } from "./orders";

// Introspected as a lookup: a 6-row code list: referenced by 1 table(s), references none, 3 or fewer simple columns.
export const shippers = defineTable("shippers", {
    columns: {
        shipperId: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        companyName: col.varchar(40).notNull(),
        phone: col.varchar(24)
    },
    relations: {
        orders: rel.hasMany(() => orders, { foreignKey: "ship_via" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
